slice: Windows dependency graph, third-party licence/NOTICE consistency, runtime dependency survey
product_source: 87922dd567187bec88186944247d1f5644ba2a1b (unchanged by this slice: no product, verification code or NOTICE change was needed)

a_windows_dependency_graph.command: cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --filter-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, then a normal+build traversal from the cos-desktop binary

edge_kinds_separated.dev_only: excluded by construction — the traversal follows normal and build edges only

a_windows_dependency_graph.pinned: Cargo.lock and the GPUI git revision are unchanged
a_windows_dependency_graph.note: this is the build-time dependency closure, not a proof of what is linked into the executable

b_third_party_licences.why_the_16_matter: a declared SPDX expression is not the licence text, and Apache-2.0 §4(a) requires supplying a copy of the licence with a distribution; their text has to be collected before any package leaves the internal stage

notice_files_found_in_fetched_sources.content: carries an MIT permission notice for code derived from tectonic_cfg_support::target_cfg!

unicode.existing_notice_entry: the repository NOTICE already names Unicode 16.0.0 simple case-folding data and points at the generated file

b_third_party_licences.not_a_legal_conclusion: this record lists declared expressions and the presence of text files. It does not decide whether every obligation is met.

c_runtime_dependencies.starting_point: the published binary-survey.json for the staged executable (34 direct import labels, x86_64, unsigned, delay-import directory zero)

classes_separated.system_dlls: KERNEL32, USER32, GDI32, ntdll, bcryptprimitives, USERENV and the api-ms-win-* API sets observed directly
classes_separated.redistributable_candidates: VCRUNTIME140 and the api-ms-win-crt-* set — the MSVC runtime, whose redistribution terms are not decided here
classes_separated.delay_load: NOT_INSPECTED — the delay-import directory is zero in the observed image
classes_separated.transitive_or_dynamic: NOT_MEASURED — a direct-import list cannot prove closure

claims_not_made: no permissive claim for the MSVC runtime

d_notice_consistency.current_notice: names Apache-2.0 for COS Desktop and the Unicode data entry only
d_notice_consistency.finding: every declared dependency uses a permissive family expression, but two obligations are not yet satisfied by the four-file internal package: the licence texts of the 16 packages without a local copy, and the cfg_aliases NOTICES.md attribution for Apache-2.0 §4(d)
d_notice_consistency.change_made: none — adding attributions without the licence texts, or shipping a NOTICE that implies compliance, would be worse than stating the gap
d_notice_consistency.decision_needed: before any distribution, either extend the package file set to carry the required licence texts and notices, or record a Caller-approved distribution decision that changes the four-file rule. Both are outside this slice and outside the current four-file internal contract.

commands_run: source scan of ~/.cargo/registry/src for licence and NOTICE files among the 368 packages

verification.gate: none — no product or verification code changed (ADR-0014 Y04)
